LESSON: KUSOMA 10.2.1 MATINI YA KIDIJITALI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: KUDHIBITI ITIKADI ZA KIDINI NA ZA KIJAMII Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayot
Topic 10.2: Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali
2. kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
3. kusakura kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kusakura kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma
   In simple words: practise until you can kusakura kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali.
4. Show that you can: kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 10.2.1 Matini ya Kidijitali important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali
2. kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
3. kusakura kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
